content.text: {"id": "mm7112a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "National incidence of reported TB (cases per 100,000 persons) rose 9.4% during 2021 (2.37) compared with that in 2020 (2.16)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A total of 7,860 TB cases were reported during 2021, 687 more than during 2020 (7,173)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Incidence (cases per 100,000 population) among U.S.-born persons increased from 0.71 in 2020 to 0.79 in 2021"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "9.3% (507 of 5,456) received a diagnosis <1 year after arrival in the United States"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "National incidence of reported TB (cases per 100,000 persons) rose 9.4% during 2021 (2.37) compared with that in 2020 (2.16)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "From 2020 to 2021, TB incidence decreased 0.4% among U.S.-born Black persons and 5.7% among U.S.-born NH/OPI persons"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Health departments in the 50 U.S. states and DC report TB cases to CDC"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "U.S. TB incidence during 2021 increased by 9.4% following a large decrease during 2020"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Percent changes in incidence were calculated using unrounded figures."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "those with unknown results or for whom testing was reported as not performed were excluded"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Persons with missing race or ethnicity data are excluded from calculations of proportions."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Incidence rates were not calculated for these categories because population estimates were not available."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
